title: From Scores to Samples: Elastic Forcing for Autoregressive Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.35491v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Few-step autoregressive video generation commonly relies on Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD), requiring a bidirectional diffusion teacher and an online fake-score model. We instead learn the rollout distribution directly from reference videos, eliminating both score models during post-training. Our framework minimizes maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) in frozen self-supervised video representation spaces, using a hybrid Nystr\"om--Monte Carlo estimator to balance approximation bias and sampling variance. Memory-efficient replay and gradient subsampling make this objective practical. Using the same architecture and initialization as Self-Forcing, our 1.3B model improves the VBench Total score from 83.80 to 84.64 while retaining 17 FPS. translated_title: 从分数到样本：自回归视频生成的弹性强制方法
translated_abstract: 少步自回归视频生成通常依赖于分布匹配蒸馏（DMD），这需要一个双向扩散教师模型和一个在线伪分数模型。我们转而直接从参考视频学习模型推理分布，从而在后训练阶段同时消除了这两个分数模型。我们的框架在冻结的自监督视频表示空间中最小化最大均值差异（MMD），并使用一种混合Nyström-蒙特卡罗估计器来平衡近似偏差与采样方差。内存高效的回放机制和梯度子采样使该目标得以实际应用。使用与Self-Forcing相同的架构和初始化，我们的13亿参数模型将VBench总分从83.80提升至84.64，同时保持17 FPS的生成速度。去除辅助分数模型还使得仅用8块H200 GPU即可进行140亿参数模型的后训练。除了蒸馏之外，从参考视频学习还使模型能够获取新的视觉风格和语义（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出Elastic Forcing方法，直接在冻结的自监督表示空间中通过MMD从参考视频学习自回归视频生成模型的推理分布，完全摆脱了分数模型的依赖，不仅将1.3B模型的VBench分数从83.80提升到84.64并保持17 FPS，还首次实现了仅用8块H200 GPU对14B模型进行后训练。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Elastic Forcing, which learns the rollout distribution directly from reference videos via MMD in frozen self-supervised representation spaces, eliminating the need for both teacher and fake-score models, improving VBench from 83.80 to 84.64 at 17 FPS and enabling 14B post-training on just eight H200 GPUs.
